related_questions.snippet: Bryant-Denny Stadium at The University of Alabama has a clear bag and purse policy for all events. Bags can be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and cannot exceed 12” X 6” X 12” or one-gallon clear plastic freezer bags (Ziploc bag or similar). Clear bags containing logos must have logos no larger than 4.5” tall X 3.4” wide.
